description: This file contains the class definition for Opencart.Catalog.Model.Setting.Store, which manages store-related data and operations within the OpenCart project. It includes methods for retrieving store information, creating store instances, and managing store configurations based on store ID or hostname.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Represents store management functionalities, including retrieving store details, creating store instances, and handling store configurations within the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific store by its store ID.

methods.name: getStoreByHostname
methods.description: Retrieves store details based on its hostname URL.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Fetches a list of all stores with caching support.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Initializes and sets up a new store instance with required configurations, event handlers, and language settings.
